debugData.name: Showcase coast terrain
debugData.description: terrainShowcase's coast (p310 §3.3): sand01 (the dunes), sand02 (the beach along the waterline), rocks01 (gravel at the cliff foot) and cliffs01 (the cliff face, triplanar past a 35-50° slope gate) weighed by the block's COLOR_0 (RGB_AO, the AO on indirect light) through the height blend, HEX on the dominant layer and DUAL_SCALE on the others (which samples in slots: a set array, the scene's textureSetArrays entry), the macro variation, and wet: the shoreline along the scene's water level with waves running up, puddles and rain ripples.
